title: Figures reaching for stars
slide_intent: Coordinate a group’s small actions because shared movement can make an illustration feel socially connected.
strategic_value: The lively cluster on yellow can give Mailchimp’s drawn world a celebratory character.
demonstration: A short loop shows a stack of irregular figures shifting and reaching among stars beneath a crescent moon.
practical_value: Study how small pose changes animate a compact illustration without replacing its composition.

content_islands.name: Figure cluster
content_islands.spec: Center the linked figures and preserve the shifting poses within their shared silhouette.

content_islands.name: Sky details
content_islands.spec: Place stars and crescent around the upper cluster on the continuous yellow field.

reference_purposes.Expression: The loop animates a compact group of drawn figures against yellow.
